# Abstract

-   Exploring how audiological patterns in wildlife were affected by eclipse.

-   Goal: address correlation between audio clips in model.

-   **Key findings:**

    - A first-order autoregressive term to the GAMM addressed correlation.
  
    - Approximately 1/2 audiomoths displayed clear spike in BEI index.

# Background

-   20 audio recording devices deployed in the Northern New York area.

-   Data on 5 audiological indices recorded, including BEI (Bioacoustic Index), which measures diversity of noise.

<!-- -   Day of eclipse was April 8th, totality period was 15:23:52 - 15:25:29. -->

<!-- high values correspond to more species making noise; low values suggest fewer species making sound. -->

# Data

```{r}
A001_SD001 <- readRDS(here::here("A001_SD001.rds"))
A002_SD013 <- readRDS(here::here("A002_SD013.rds"))
A003_SD005 <- readRDS(here::here("A003_SD005.rds"))
A004_SD012 <- readRDS(here::here("A004_SD012.rds"))
A005_SD002 <- readRDS(here::here("A005_SD002.rds"))
A006_SD006 <- readRDS(here::here("A006_SD006.rds"))
A007_SD017 <- readRDS(here::here("A007_SD017.rds"))
A008_SD007 <- readRDS(here::here("A008_SD007.rds"))
A009_SD009 <- readRDS(here::here("A009_SD009.rds"))
A010_SD014 <- readRDS(here::here("A010_SD014.rds"))
A011_SD018 <- readRDS(here::here("A011_SD018.rds"))
A013_SD016 <- readRDS(here::here("A013_SD016.rds"))
A014_SD021 <- readRDS(here::here("A014_SD021.rds"))
A015_SD010 <- readRDS(here::here("A015_SD010.rds"))
A016_SD022 <- readRDS(here::here("A016_SD022.rds"))
A017_SD024 <- readRDS(here::here("A017_SD024.rds"))
A018_SD011 <- readRDS(here::here("A018_SD011.rds"))
A019_SD008 <- readRDS(here::here("A019_SD008.rds"))
A021_SD023 <- readRDS(here::here("A021_SD023.rds"))
A022_SD019 <- readRDS(here::here("A022_SD019.rds"))

eclipse_start<-hms(00,00,14)
eclipse_end<-hms(00,50,16)

full_audio <- rbind(A001_SD001, A002_SD013, A003_SD005, A004_SD012,
                    A005_SD002, A006_SD006, A007_SD017, A008_SD007,
                    A009_SD009, A010_SD014, A011_SD018, A013_SD016,
                    A014_SD021, A015_SD010, A016_SD022, A017_SD024,
                    A018_SD011, A019_SD008, A021_SD023, A022_SD019)|>
  group_by(folder_name)|>
  mutate(folder_name = as_factor(folder_name)) |>
  mutate(fullACI = sapply(ACI_all,sum))|>
  mutate(fullADI = sapply(ADI_all, sum)) |>
  mutate(hour_numeric = as.numeric(hour))|>
  filter(hour>= eclipse_start & hour<= eclipse_end) |>
  filter(day %in% c("2024-04-06", "2024-04-07", "2024-04-08",
                    "2024-04-09", "2024-04-11")) |>
  mutate(audiomoth_day = interaction(folder_name, day))

table <- full_audio |>
  select(day, hour, folder_name, hour_numeric, bei, aei, biophony) |>
  rename(Audiomoth = folder_name) |>
  mutate(Audiomoth = recode(
    Audiomoth,
    '"/A001_SD001"' = "Audiomoth 01"
  ))
  
pander(head(table, 3))
```

# Data Exploration

- Time series of one audiomoth on day of eclipse (April 8th).

```{r, out.width = "100%"}
apr8_am1 <- A001_SD001 |>
  mutate(hour_numeric = as.numeric(hour)) |>
  filter(day == "2024-04-08") |>
filter(hour>= eclipse_start & hour<= eclipse_end)

ggplot(apr8_am1, aes(x = hour_numeric, y = bei)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = "turquoise4") +
  labs(
    title = "Time Series of BEI on April 8, 2024",
    subtitle = "Audiomoth 01",
    x = "Time",
    y = "BEI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 24) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Time", breaks = c(eclipse_start, hms(00,00,15), hms(00,00,16), eclipse_end))
```

- Spike in BEI seen during period of totality.

# Fitted Model

- Plot of fitted model for BEI through time for nine of twenty audiomoths.

```{r, out.width = "100%"}
mod1 <- readRDS(here::here("Modeling_Files/mod1.rds"))

audio9 <- full_audio |>
  filter(folder_name %in% c('"/A001_SD001"', '"/A003_SD005"','"/A010_SD014"', '"/A013_SD016"', '"/A014_SD021"', '"/A015_SD010"','"/A016_SD022"', '"/A017_SD024"', '"/A021_SD023"'))

grid9 <- audio9 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(folder_name, day) %>%
  group_by(folder_name, day) %>%
  tidyr::expand(hour_numeric = seq_range(full_audio$hour_numeric, n = 40)) %>%
  mutate(audiomoth_day = interaction(folder_name, day, drop = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(day = as.factor(day))

gam_aug1 <- broom::augment(mod1$gam, newdata = grid9)

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = audio9, 
             aes(x = hour_numeric, y = bei), 
             alpha = 0.4, color = "gray70") +
  geom_line(data = gam_aug1, 
            aes(x = hour_numeric, y = .fitted, 
            color = day), linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ folder_name,
             labeller = labeller(
               folder_name = c(
                 '"/A001_SD001"' = "Audiomoth 01",
                 '"/A003_SD005"' = "Audiomoth 03",
                 '"/A010_SD014"' = "Audiomoth 10",
                 '"/A013_SD016"' = "Audiomoth 13",
                 '"/A014_SD021"' = "Audiomoth 14",
                 '"/A015_SD010"' = "Audiomoth 15",
                 '"/A016_SD022"' = "Audiomoth 16",
                 '"/A017_SD024"' = "Audiomoth 17",
                 '"/A021_SD023"' = "Audiomoth 21")),
             scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Fitted GAMM Model for BEI as Seen Through Nine Audiomoths",
       x = "Hour (numeric)", 
       y = "BEI",
       color = "Day") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title      = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  axis.title.x    = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 8),
  axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 10),
  strip.text      = element_text(size = 16),
  legend.title    = element_text(size = 16),
  legend.text     = element_text(size = 11)) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Time", breaks = c(eclipse_start, hms(00,00,15), hms(00,00,16), eclipse_end)) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d()

grid <- full_audio %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(folder_name, day) %>%
  group_by(folder_name, day) %>%
  tidyr::expand(hour_numeric = seq_range(full_audio$hour_numeric, n = 40)) %>%
  mutate(audiomoth_day = interaction(folder_name, day, drop = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(day = as.factor(day))
```

# Model Continued
The general form of a GAMM is shown below:
$$
y_{iad} = \beta_{ad} + f_{ad}(t_{iad}) + \epsilon_{iad},
$$

- $y_{id}$ is the response for the metric of interest (e.g., BEI, AEI, etc.) for the $i^{th}$ observation recorded on the $a^{th}$ audiomoth($a = 1, 2, \ldots, 20$) on the $d^{th}$ day of recording ($d = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5$).

- $\beta_{ad}$ is a an intercept term that changes for each audiomoth-day combination.

- $f_{ad}(t_{iad})$ is a smoother term for time (indexed by $i$) that changes for each audiomoth-day combination.

- $t_{iad}$ is the time (in seconds) that the $i^{th}$ observation was recorded at the $a^{th}$ audiomoth and the $d^{th}$ day.

- $\epsilon_{iad}$ are random errors that follow an AR(1) temporal correlation structure for each audiomoth-day combination with common shared correlation parameter $p$.

# Takeaways

- First-order autoregressive term addressed correlation in original model.

- Approximately 1/2 audiomoths displayed clear spike in BEI during totality.

- Other indices revealed potential patterns, but lack of evidence.

- Certain audiomoths may have recorded patterns more than others.
